cr_data.provenance: (The Intimate Gallery, New York, NY); Oliver B. James, New York, NY, 1929; Mabel Davis James, Phoenix, Arizona, gift, 1939; Lester J. Shaffer, Phoenix, Arizona, gift, 1968; Private collection, Phoenix, Arizona, bequest, 1983 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Letter from Oliver B. James . . . . March 5, 1946: "We own . . . 'White Rose' . . . Unsigned, in good condition . . . purchased by me from An American Place . . . Belongs to my wife, Mabel Davis James. . . .' Sold to Oliver James." (Source: Lynes, 1999)
